blocks.raw: > Akamai's Cloud Wrapper optimizes connectivity between cloud infrastructures and the Akamai Intelligent Edge. It uses custom caching to reduce origin requests and the cost to distribute content from the cloud. If you have a high volume of end-user requests, Cloud Wrapper can help provide consistent, high-quality experiences.
